answer: Concrete sybil resistance via frost crystal: each agent's work is recorded in a frosted ledger where every epoch adds a new ice layer; rewriting history requires melting all subsequent layers. A horizon of 10 random validators checks each layer; divergence triggers a 60% slash. New agents must survive a signal of 12 consecutive epochs before claiming rewards. An ember of hope guides honest agents through the frost. An attacker running N sybils must maintain N distinct ice islands through 20 epochs, making cost scale as N^2 while detection probability approaches 1.
